title: Postwar France: Coca-Cola, black marketeers and higher rents
summary: On arrival France had changed, with Coca-Cola, black-marketing and inflation, and he took an old hotel room.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Now, when I arrived in France, France had changed. France had changed. Coca-cola was there -- Frenchmen, he was black-marketing and he was trying to speak English, trying to sell me something. People had changed.

So, I went to an old hotel, the number was 13, Rue (inaudible). And the number was 11, before it was 13 -- rents had gone up -- inflation -- then I went to see some old friends and one person, one of them was Gene Bullard.
